Local and patient-level auxiliary gradients reach prediction backbones
Encoder prediction bypasses all auxiliary projectors
Local head preserves shared parameter initialization and RNG state
Historical projected prediction and checkpoint parameter layout supported
Legacy within averaging and independent coefficient overrides
Four common modes, per-term logs and validation checkpoint selection
Disabled auxiliary terms use only the reference prediction path
Invalid local view sources and invalid coefficients rejected
Synthetic cached-H5 CLI, checkpoint reload and label-free prediction
Constant dimensions reported without claiming collapse prevention

No real UNI weights loaded or real WSI pixels decoded
No patient training or clinical efficacy evaluation
No causal, biological disentanglement or novelty claim established
Training remains full-batch padding; scalable patient minibatches not implemented
